criteria: Not present in this note at all
Barely present - mentioned once, in passing
Present strongly - the note dwells on it
Dominant - the note is largely about this
question.instructions: How strongly does the note foreground structural elements (tannin, acidity, minerality) as the defining, dominant character of the wine, rather than treating fruit or immediate pleasure as the main point?

standard_answer.note:
因为这段明显把“结构”当成核心之一：
- 开头直接说 The structure and the richness are just right
- 明确提到 ripe acidity
- 又强调 a dense, complex structure
- tight apple skin finish 也强化了紧致、骨架感
虽然 plums and apricots 这些水果风味也很明显，但水果并不是唯一重点，反而被描述为与结构相平衡。
